svg.title: North Pacific Current: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 4700 km. NOAA glossary regional extent from about 160 degrees E to an OSW gate at 145 degrees W, somewhat beyond the source's approximate 150 degrees W region. Alternative ends at 150 degrees W. This convention excludes downstream Alaska/California branches and the Kuroshio Extension. It is not the entire Japan-to-North-America circulation or a universal naming extent; AMS describes a different western origin near 170 degrees W. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate NOAA North Pacific regional extent — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 162 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: NOAA currents glossary; OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
